```{r, presets, , message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}

library(readxl)

library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
panderOptions("table.split.table", Inf)
```

```{r, Total Scores, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
class_roll <- readRDS("./class_roll_250516.RDS")
total <-
  read_excel(path = "./data/Final_Records_2501_0622.xlsx",
             range = "A1:L597",
             col_types = c(rep("text", 6), rep("numeric", 6)))
total <- data.frame(total)
# total[, 7:12] <- sapply(total[, 7:12], unclass)
nas <- which(is.na(total), arr.ind = TRUE)
total[nas] <- 0.0
# total[which(total == "-", arr.ind = TRUE)]
# total[, 7:12] <- sapply(total[, 7:12], function(x)`class<-`(x, "numeric"))
# str(total)
total <- total[c(3, 1, 7:12)]
# total <- total[c(2, 1, 3:8)]
v_names_total <- c("ID", "Name", "Online_Att", "Online_Quiz", "TED_Quiz", "Google_Att", "Data_Lab", "Total")
names(total) <- v_names_total
# class(total[, "Google_Att"]) <- "numeric"
## 점수 환산
# total[, "Google_Att"] <- total[, "Google_Att"] * 0.05
# total[, "Data_Lab"] <- total[, "Data_Lab"] * 0.3
# army_ID <- setdiff(total$ID, class_roll_final$ID)
army_ID <- 
  c("20182982", 
    "20204124", 
    "20213353", 
    "20215202", 
    "20222962", 
    "20226281", 
    "20231010", 
    "20232998",
    "20235101",
    "20235120")
army_records <- total[total$ID %in% army_ID, ] 
total <- total[total$ID %in% setdiff(total$ID, army_ID), ]
```
## 군휴학생 성적부

```{r, echo = FALSE}
pander(army_records[order(army_records$ID), ], row.names = FALSE)
```

## 재학생 점수 히스토그램

```{r, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
if(sum(FA) > 0) {
    total <- total[!FA, ]
    }
#> 중국인 유학생 배려
# total[total$ID == "20218005", "Total"] <- 86
total <- total %>%
  mutate(Total = if_else(ID == "20218005", Total + 1.29, Total))
#> 점수분포표
total$Total %>%  
  cut(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10), 
      include.lowest = TRUE, 
      right = FALSE) %>%
  table %>%
  as.matrix %>%
  t %>%
  pander
h <- 
  total$Total %>% 
  hist(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 5), 
       include.lowest = TRUE,
       right = FALSE,
       yaxt = "n",
       prob = FALSE, 
       col = "white",
       main = "Histogram")
axis(side = 1, at = seq(0, 100,  by = 10), labels = seq(0, 100, by = 10))
axis(side = 2, at = h$counts, labels = h$counts, las = 2)
```

## 재학생 점수 분포표

```{r, echo = FALSE}
Counts_tbl <- total$Total %>% 
  cut(breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60, 70, 86, 90, 93.5, 95, 100),
      labels = c("[0 ~ 20)", 
                 "[20 ~ 40)",
                 "[40 ~ 60)",
                 "[60 ~ 70)", 
                 "[70 ~ 86)", 
                 "[86 ~ 90)", 
                 "[90 ~ 93.5)",
                 "[93.5 ~ 95)", 
                 "[95 ~ 100]"), 
      include.lowest = TRUE, 
      right = FALSE) %>%
  table %>%
  rev %>% 
  t %>% 
  `row.names<-`("Counts") %>%
# row.names(scores_tbl) <- "Counts"
# scores_tbl %>%
  cbind("계" = rowSums(.)) %>%
  t
Prop_tbl <- total$Total %>% 
  cut(breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60, 70, 86, 90, 93.5, 95, 100),
      labels = c("[0 ~ 20)", 
                 "[20 ~ 40)",
                 "[40 ~ 60)",
                 "[60 ~ 70)", 
                 "[70 ~ 86)", 
                 "[86 ~ 90)", 
                 "[90 ~ 93.5)",
                 "[93.5 ~ 95)", 
                 "[95 ~ 100]"), 
      include.lowest = TRUE, 
      right = FALSE) %>%
  table %>%
  prop.table %>%
  `*`(100) %>%
  round(digits = 2) %>%
  rev %>% 
  t %>% 
  `row.names<-`("Percentages") %>%
# row.names(scores_tbl) <- "Counts"
# scores_tbl %>%
  cbind("계" = rowSums(.)) %>%
  t 
Grades <- c("A+", "A0", "B+", "B0", "C+", "C0", "D+", "D0", "F", "")
# cbind(Counts_tbl, Prop_tbl, Grades) %>%
Cumulative_tbl <- cumsum(Prop_tbl)[-length(cumsum(Prop_tbl))]
cbind("Counts(명)" = Counts_tbl, 
      "Percentage(%)" = Prop_tbl, 
      "Cumulative Percentage(%)" = c(Cumulative_tbl, "")) %>%
  pander()
```

## 성적 등급 

```{r, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
# str(total)
total$Grades <- total$Total %>% 
  cut(breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60, 70, 86, 90, 93.5, 95, 100), 
      include.lowest = TRUE, 
      right = FALSE) %>%
  factor(levels = c("[95,100]", 
                    "[93.5,95)",
                    "[90,93.5)", 
                    "[86,90)",
                    "[70,86)", 
                    "[60,70)",
                    "[40,60)",
                    "[20,40)", 
                    "[0,20)"),
         labels = c("A+", "A0", "B+", "B0", "C+", "C0", "D+", "D0", "F"))
counts <- total$Grades %>%
  table %>% 
  c("계" = sum(.))
perc <- total$Grades %>%
  table %>% 
  prop.table %>%
  c("계" = sum(.)) %>%
  `*`(100) %>%
  round(digits = 2) 
#> 대체 수강자 중 A+ => A0
counts2 <- total$Grades %>%
  table %>% 
  c("계" = sum(.))
perc2 <- total$Grades %>%
  table %>%
  prop.table %>%
  c("계" = sum(.)) %>%
  `*`(100) %>%
  round(digits = 2) 
# rbind("Counts" = counts2, 
#       "Percentage" = perc2, 
#       "Cumulative" = cumsum(perc2)) %>%
#   cbind("Sum" = rowSums(.)) %>%
#  format(digits = 1, nsmall = 1) %>%
rbind("Counts" = format(counts2, digits = 1, nsmall = 0), 
      "Percentage(%)" = format(perc2, digits = 1, nsmall = 1), 
      "Cumulative(%)" = format(cumsum(perc2), digits = 1, nsmall = 1)) %>%
# cbind("Sum" = rowSums(.)) %>%
#   format(digits = 1, nsmall = 1) %>%
  `[<-`(3, 10, "") %>%
  kable(align = "r")
```

```{r, individual scores, eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
v_names_kr <- c("학번", "이름", "온라인출석", "복습퀴즈", "TED 퀴즈", "데이터실험퀴즈", "구글설문지 참여", "총점", "등급")
total_kr <- total 
names(total_kr) <- v_names_kr
my_grade <- function(id){
  kable(total_kr[total$ID %in% id, -1], row.names = FALSE)
}
my_grade <- function(id){
  kable(total_kr[total$ID %in% id, -1], 
        row.names = FALSE)
}
# my_grade(c("20246942"))
# my_grade(c("이상민"))
```

```{r, eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
total_kr$"등급" %<>% 
  as.character
my_grade_print <-
  function(id){
    paste0(
      paste(names(total_kr[total$ID %in%  id, -1]),
            total_kr[total$ID %in% id, -1], 
            sep = " : "),
      c("", "/20", "/30", "/20", "/20", "/10", "/100", ""),
      collapse = "\t")
  }
my_grade_print("20218005") %>%
  data.frame(Grade_Report = .) %>%
  kable
#> x at the top remove
sapply(c("20171054", "20256785", "20241232"), 
       FUN = my_grade_print) %>%
data.frame(Grade_Report = ., stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
kable(escape = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = NA)
```
